about: Worked out with WoWSims Forever's own Stat Weights tool (wowsims.com/forever/warlock/dps, game 1.60.1.70938). Its Aff (Wrack) preset (talents 35/11/5, rotation, buffs) on its own pre-raid gear set (preraid.gear.json, imported as SIML by item ID), 12,500 iterations, reference stat Spell Damage. DPS EP as the tool shows it; '1%' rows are per 1%. Run in John's Chrome on 14 Nov 2026 (US Central).
